scope: Correct the generic group-code category for code 1005

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaDwgSpecification.finding: The EED group-code table identifies 1005 as an entity-handle reference. Targeted text extraction found no AcDbAssocAction, ACDBASSOCACTION, or AcDbEvalVariant value-layout entry; the EED description does not establish the associative-action data/string/handle-stream grammar.

localSource.finding: The generic value-kind helper previously classified 1005-1009 as strings and the AcDbAssocAction parser consumed that category as variable text. Its class-specific value grammar is still unresolved.

production: The generic resbuf group-code category now identifies 1005 as Handle.
Added associativeActionValueKind(), which returns Invalid for 1005-1009 until an authoritative class-specific encoding is available.
DRW_AssociativeObject::parseDwg uses the consumer-specific category and refuses those values before typed payload consumption; the existing opaque failed-frame route remains intact.
generatedTests: The generic group-code test expects 1005 to classify as Handle.
Generated AC1024 AcDbAssocAction frames require consumer-specific refusal for 1005-1009.
The remaining supported values retain their independent body-sentinel and per-value handle-count checks.
